channel.description: Latest articles from Space.com (Future plc US Inc.) (space.com)

item.title: NASA X-ray spacecraft stares into the 'eye of the storm' swirling around supermassive black holes
item.description: The NASA/JAXA X-ray spacecraft has allowed astronomers to dive into the metaphorical "eye of the storm" swirling around supermassive black holes.

item.title: It's toys vs technology in the 1st 'Toy Story 5' trailer, and the toys have an army of Buzz Lightyears
item.description: The lovable old-school Toy Story gang takes on mesmerizing modern digital devices in the first trailer for Pixar's "Toy Story 5."

item.title: These 70 dusty galaxies at the edge of our universe could rewrite our understanding of the cosmos
item.description: Using the James Webb Space Telescope, astronomers have investigated 70 dusty galaxies at the very edge of the universe that challenge our understanding of cosmic evolution.

item.title: The Milky Way may be hiding a big secret at its heart: an extremely magnetic dead star
item.description: Astronomers suspect the heart of the Milky Way may be hiding a big secret: a rapidly spinning, highly magnetic, neutron star-powered pulsar.

item.title: Can you really survive on Mars? What science fiction gets wrong about off-world living
item.description: Arnie said, "Get your ass to Mars", but is it really a good idea? We asked the experts about our Martian future.

item.title: What's the point of a space station around the moon?
item.description: Is an orbiting space station necessary to achieve lunar objectives, including scientific ones?

item.title: Canon PowerShot V1 review
item.description: I tried out Canon's latest vlogging camera for astrophotography, the PowerShot V1 and managed to capture the Andromeda galaxy and the Milky Way!

item.title: This Week In Space podcast: Episode 198 — A Dragonfly on Titan
item.description: On Episode 198 of This Week In Space, Rod Pyle and Tariq Malik talk with Principal Investigator Dr. Elizabeth "Zibi" Turtle about the Dragonfly mission and what to expect in the coming years.

item.title: NASA's Artemis 2 moon rocket has a new problem. 'This will almost assuredly impact the March launch window.'
item.description: NASA is troubleshooting a glitch with the upper stage of Artemis 2's Space Launch System rocket that will likely delay the launch of the moon mission.

item.title: Falcon 9 rocket sets new reuse record on SpaceX's 2nd Starlink launch of the day
item.description: Two SpaceX Falcon 9 rockets, each carrying Starlink satellites, launched from California and Florida on Saturday, Feb. 21, 2026. The second booster set a new reuse record.
